title: UPI Collect Guard
description: Stops people "entering their PIN to receive" money by showing a collect request as the payment it is (You pay ₹4,999 to…), asking whether they expect money and turning a yes into a decline-only stop, and flagging refund, prize, OLX-buyer and KYC wording, person-to-person collects (switched off by NPCI on 1 Oct 2025), unknown requesters and small test amounts before the PIN screen.
stops: Entered UPI PIN to receive money
mistakes: upi pin to receive money scam
